title: Shared Templates
description: Shared, server-side VS Code snippets, dynamically loaded from the IFS. Behaves like a native VS Code user snippet (prefix/body/description).

name.title: Name
name.description: The display name of the template.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Typed to trigger the snippet completion.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what this snippet is for.

body.title: Body
body.description: The snippet body, one array entry per line. May contain tabstop/placeholder syntax such as $1, ${1:default}.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: File extensions this snippet applies to. Use GLOBAL (the default) to apply to any file.
